title: Max Consecutive Ones III
summary: Given a binary array nums and an integer k, return the maximum number of consecutive 1's in the array that can be achieved by flipping at most k zeros.
statement: Given a binary array nums and an integer k, return the maximum number of consecutive 1's in the array that can be achieved by flipping at most k zeros.
constraints: Flip at most k zeros to ones.
Return the longest contiguous run of ones obtainable.
reference_solution:
def longest_ones_after_flips(nums, k):
 left=zeros=best=0
 for right,value in enumerate(nums):
  zeros+=value==0
  while zeros>k:zeros-=nums[left]==0;left+=1
  best=max(best,right-left+1)
 return best
